evidence.note: Supports the planning-limitation component for tested models, but does not isolate absent or unstable world representations as its cause.
Causal board-state representations in a synthetic Othello model challenge blanket architectural claims, but do not establish dependable general reasoning in representative LLMs.
World-state prediction combined with search and rewards improves performance. The combined intervention does not isolate representation stability as the causal factor.

reviews.rationale: Planning unreliability has empirical support, but the asserted cause of both planning and reasoning failures remains unestablished. Narrow representation findings and combined planning interventions do not settle the causal proposition across contemporary LLMs.
